markdownArray.embeddedContent:
**IMPORTANT INFORMATION**

NetZoom Enterprise and NetZoom Visio Stencils (collectively NetZoom) are products of NetZoom, Inc.

Your purchase and use of NetZoom is subject to your acceptance of the product End User License Agreement (EULA) which can be found at Service.NetZoom.com.

DCM (Data Center Manager) is a licensed companion product to NetZoom Enterprise that provides power and thermal monitoring. If DCM is installed, its usage is subject to the DCM Eula.

# THANK YOU FOR YOUR ORDER

If your order includes:

- NetZoom Visio Stencils, please visit Service.NetZoom.com to access the Stencils.
- NetZoom Enterprise, please visit Service.NetZoom.com to download the setup, documentation and other materials.
- Services, Training or you need Technical support, please visit Service.NetZoom.com to request your services and schedule training.

To purchase additional products, services or renew subscriptions, you may contact your sales representative, email <Sales@NetZoom.com> or call 630.281.6464 (Central Time Zone, USA).

# NETZOOM SERVICE PORTAL

The NetZoom Service Portal is available 24x7. It provides access to the EULA, more stencils/shape requests, service requests and downloadable files: stencils, setup files, and brochures. Registration is required. Visit the NetZoom Service Portal at Service.NetZoom.com.

# EXCHANGES AND REFUNDS

There are no refunds or exchanges on NetZoom purchases, implementation/professional service incidence or hours, or training.

**RENEWABLE SUBSCRIPTION SERVICE**
NetZoom software is licensed to you, not sold, as an annual renewable subscription service.

# COMPLIMENTARY SERVICES

All subscriptions includes following benefits, offered during term of a valid subscription:

- Access to the Online NetZoom Device Library of Shapes/Stencils
- Access to Online Reference Materials
- Free Device Shape/Stencil Requests
- Free Software Updates
- Free E-mail Support

With the purchase of NetZoom Enterprise, the following one time complimentary benefits are offered during first 12 months of purchase:

- 4 Hours of Online Implementation Planning Meetings.
- 6 Hours of Online User Training consisting of three 2-hour sessions.
- SAAS Deployments - Include Setup, Configuration & Managed Services Support for the SAAS Environment.
- On-Premises Deployments - Include 4 Hours of Remote Installation Support for Primary Environment. Hosted Deployments - Include Setup, Configuration & Managed Services Support for the Hosted Environment.

**BUSINESS HOURS**

Business Hours are Monday-Friday 8:30AM-5:30PM US Central Standard Time except for Holidays.

# PAID SERVICES/PROFESSIONAL SERVICE HOURS

During Business Hours, each implementation/service support incidence hour, up to one hour of professional service time, is charged at the rate of one (1) support incidence hour. Each implementation/service incidence support hour, occurring After Hours is charged the rate of one and a half (1.5) support incidence hours. After Hours support is only available by pre-arrangement. Paid services can be purchased at the time of placing an order or at a later time. Service incidences are not sold to, nor may they be used by, those who do not possess an active (non-expired/nonblocked) license/subscription. Purchased incidence hours for Support/Professional services must be used within 2 years from original date of purchase. After hour services are also available for purchase.

# NETZOOM VISIO STENCILS

This product is not offered on media. If ordering NetZoom Visio Stencils, NetZoom Visio Stencils Library service is available for use by licensed users subject to reasonable use. Reasonable use for a single subscription on downloads is limited to downloading Visio stencils of 50 manufacturers or any 100 Visio stencils within a 12-month period. Device Shape requests per subscription are limited to 30 shape requests in a 12-month period. NetZoom, Inc. reserves the right to limit downloads or revoke the subscription if the subscription is used to download stencils beyond reasonable use.

**HOW DO I DOWNLOAD NETZOOM VISIO STENCILS?**

NetZoom Visio Stencils can be downloaded through the Customer Service Portal located at: Service.NetZoom.com. You must have a subscription for NetZoom Visio Stencils to download stencils.

First, select required stencils from the NetZoom Stencil Library and drag them into My Stencils.

Next, check the stencils in My Stencils and click the Download button to download the files to the Downloads directory of your machine.

# ORDER BY PHONE OR FAX OR E-MAIL OR POSTAL MAIL OR COURIER

Call 630.281.6464 (Central Time Zone/USA) or E-mail your completed order form or Purchase Order to

<Sales@NetZoom.com> or send to Sales Manager, NetZoom, Inc., 3030 Warrenville Road, Suite 225, Lisle, IL 60532,

USA

**PAY BY CREDIT CARD**

VISA, MASTERCARD and AMERICAN EXPRESS are accepted credit cards for payments.

# USING ELECTRONIC WIRE TRANSFER

Call 630.281.6464 (Central Time Zone, USA) or write an email to <Sales@NetZoom.com> to receive wire transfer information. When ordering, you must send a copy of the bank wire transfer receipt along with the order.

# USING PURCHASE ORDERS

Purchase orders are accepted from authorized Resellers and Distributors, Educational institutions of repute, State and Federal government agencies, large corporations and companies located in United States and Canada ONLY. Payment terms are NET 30 days. An authorized purchase order must be attached with the order form.

**INTERNATIONAL ORDERS**

All International orders must be pre-paid using one of the following methods: Credit Card, Wire Transfer or Check.

# SALES TAX AND OTHER TAXES

Purchases may include sales tax based on the ship-to address; sales tax, if applicable will be at the rate in effect at the time of purchase. We will only charge sales tax in states where such taxes apply. Customer will be responsible for any other taxes such as VAT, custom duty etc. if applicable. If you are Tax Exempt then please include Tax Exempt document along with your order.

# SUBSCRIPTION AND EXPIRED SUBSCRIPTION

Your NetZoom software subscription will start on the date the order is processed, unless clearly specified in the order. Renewal subscriptions start on the expiration date of the previous subscription. If your subscription has expired, you will not be able to access any NetZoom product. Customers must renew their subscription prior to the subscription expiration.

# AUDITING FOR COMPLIANCE

NetZoom, Inc. shall be entitled to an independent audit of usage to determine compliance with the EULA or the terms of the Agreement. The audit shall be to verify the number of authorized Users or Rack Count (as applicable) and will be conducted in a manner to least likely disrupt customer business operations. While performing the audit described above on customer premises, NetZoom, Inc. and its personnel will comply with all Customer security procedures, rules, regulations, policies, holiday, and office/working schedules. You agree to submit periodic usage log reports to NetZoom, Inc.

# CRITICAL CONTROL APPLICATIONS

Any use of NetZoom software for critical control applications is entirely at the user's own risk.
